en.headline: CityU probes orientation ‘disco night’ video, vows zero tolerance
en.dek: The university set up a student discipline panel after a social-media clip appeared to show intimate behaviour among people believed to be students at a Management Sciences Society event.
body: City University of Hong Kong said on Wednesday it had launched an investigation into an alleged indecent incident during a student-led orientation activity after a video circulated online.

The clip, labelled “D1 Disco night”, appeared to show a shirtless man carrying a woman wearing only a bra and shorts while onlookers cheered. The original Instagram post was later removed but the footage continued to circulate on Threads. The yellow shirts visible in the video bore wording linked by some online users to the Management Sciences Subject Association under the CityU Students’ Union.

CityU issued a statement pledging “zero tolerance” for improper conduct. It said it was deeply concerned about serious mismanagement and inappropriate behaviour by certain individuals and about the unnecessary disturbance experienced by participating students. A Student Discipline Panel had been established without delay.

The university said student organisations that organise orientation camps must follow guidelines issued by the Student Development Services and complete designated training, including a course on preventing sexual harassment run by the Equal Opportunities Commission. It stressed that orientation activities are intended to help new students adapt to university life and that any conduct undermining student dignity or damaging campus culture would not be tolerated.

zh.headline: 城大調查迎新「Disco Night」短片 強調零容忍不當行為
zh.dek: 社交平台流傳疑似管理科學學科聯會迎新活動短片後，城大成立紀律調查委員會，稱對損害學生尊嚴的行為絕不容忍。
body: 香港城市大學周三表示，已就一宗涉嫌不當迎新活動展開調查。社交平台流傳一段標示為「D1 Disco Night」的短片，畫面中一名赤膊男子以公主抱方式抱起一名僅穿紅色胸圍的女子，現場有人起哄。
原帖主已刪除Instagram上的影片，但片段仍在Threads上流傳。片中學生所穿黃色上衣印有字樣，部分網民指與城大學生會管理科學學科聯會有關。
城大發表聲明，強調對任何形式的不當行為採取零容忍態度。校方指對學生會屬會舉辦迎新營出現嚴重安排失當及個別人士不當行為深表關注，同時極度關注參與學生所受的不必要滋擾，已立即成立紀律調查委員會。
校方表示，正約見相關活動舉辦者，並向部分參加者搜集資料，將視乎事件嚴重性作出紀律處分。舉辦迎新營的學生組織必須遵守學生發展處指引，並完成包括平等機會委員會「防止校園性騷擾訓練課程」等指定培訓。城大重申迎新活動原意是協助新生適應大學生活，絕不容忍任何損害學生尊嚴或破壞校園文化的行為。
